استفرشوا (form X)

# اُسْتُفْرِشُوا (ustufrišū) /us.tuf.ri.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْرَشَ (istafraša)
# اِسْتَفْرِشُوا (istafrišū) /is.taf.ri.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْرَشَ (istafraša)
